statement: All geometrically abelian arithmetic sections of the plus Fermat cubic are computed, including the surjective coordinate-unit map to the toric minimum and every fiber: after a rational tangential origin the section group is (Q^{times,wedge})^2 times mu_6^3 times the restricted sequence completion R_I(Zhat) times Zhat; the pro-3 version replaces these by their 3-primary counterparts.
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d); section51.15, folios734-736, scans172-178, especially (373)-(379); the source rank-two section problem is compared with the curve's own abelianization.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: none; the plus model is fixed by B.1 and the literal coordinate-unit maps are displayed
notes: The algebraic retraction G -> G_m^2 is defined by x/z,y/z. Its kernel G' has G'(Q)=mu_6^3 direct-sum a countable free group, proved by the exact cusp-frame relation 3z'=(lambda^-1,lambda^-2,zeta^2lambda^-3) and primitive elimination. Analytic rank zero follows from the positive eta-product Mellin integral; Coates-Wiles gives Mordell-Weil rank zero. Ciperiani-Stix Theorem18(2) gives maximal Div H1(Q,E)=Q/Z without a restriction on prime3. The inverse-limit argument uses multiplication-by-m completion and finite H0, not compactness of the infinite H1 groups. A-structure independently audited the Div, inverse-limit, and toric-retraction arguments. This completes the cubic abelian case only, not the intrinsic nonabelian classification.

statement: The intrinsic marked-depth quotient maps to the inherited base-depth quotient with exact kernel (N_n intersect D_y^3)/D_intr^3; inherited rational prounipotent depth is the split base quotient at every level. For every even plus Fermat level, an explicit D8 arithmetic pullback with class kappa_2(-1) cup kappa_2(-1) has no real section, ruling out inherited pro-2 class-two/depth sections and all intrinsic quotients retaining their own pro-2 abelianization.

manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d), Lead3; section51.15, scans172-178, (371)-(379); the source does not supply an intrinsic rank-(n^2+1) depth marking.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: none; the Galois-stable markings and all quotient maps are explicitly defined
notes: At n3 choose the rational cusp above1; at n4 choose the entire four-point coordinate-cusp orbit. The image of N_even in D8 is its central C2, while the arithmetic fiber has abelian coordinates (kappa_2(-1),kappa_2(-1)); both lifts of real conjugation have square the nontrivial central element. The rational inherited comparison is a different explicit pushout whose geometric map is surjective. The intrinsic marked third-depth and third-derived kernels have a common quotient but neither contains the other; explicit Magnus words prove both noninclusions.

statement: The nonempty cubic abelian fiber over the toric pro-3 Kummer pair (6,109) has no lifts to the intrinsic class-two, intrinsic metabelian, intrinsic marked-depth, or inherited class-two pro-3 arithmetic quotients.
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d); section51.15, scans172-178, (373)-(379), applied to the cubic.
notes: The actual inherited integral lattice is H={exp(3aX+3bY+cC)}, with [3X,3Y]=9C and cyclotomic weights1,1,2. The toric comparison divides the covering exponent sums by3. H modulo27 has19683 elements and exponent27. At109 the action is trivial and6 has order108 modulo109, so all729 central lifts of Frobenius/inertia projections (1,0),(0,1) have commutator9C. The tame relation forces them to commute, giving a direct finite contradiction without continuous-H2 inverse-limit assumptions. The rational Q3 quotient has no such finite reduction map and is explicitly excluded. A-structure independently audited the arithmetic basepoint, division-by3, action, and tame-inertia steps. General intrinsic cubic nonabelian section classification remains unresolved beyond the proved obstruction.
